facts.fact: The Cyber and Data Protection Act, 2021 designates the telecom regulator POTRAZ as Data Protection Authority, and it is doing the job, with 721 licensed data controllers as of October 2025 and a 14-person data protection unit, according to POTRAZ-supplied figures.

POTRAZ says it has received 20 formal complaints, of which 15 were investigated and resolved, 3 are under investigation and 2 were dismissed for jurisdiction; it also reports 11 compliance guidance notices and findings and 20 compliance audits in 2025, and no landmark enforcement case.

facts.fact: The Cyber and Data Protection Act, 2021 is Zimbabwe's comprehensive data protection law and the report describes the legal framework as intact and operational in 2025.
POTRAZ is designated as Data Protection Authority under section 5 of the Act and is operating, with a 14-person data protection unit.
The 2022 Cyber and Data Protection Regulations and the Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers Regulations, S.I. 155 of 2024, have been made under the Act.
POTRAZ reports 20 formal complaints under the Act, 15 of them investigated and resolved, with no administrative fines available under the Act and no landmark enforcement case.
POTRAZ conducted 20 proactive compliance audits in 2025, licensed 721 controllers and issued six implementation guidelines.
The report says no legislative amendments were made during the review period.
The Cyber and Data Protection Act, 2021 is in force and the report calls the framework operational in 2025.
